entity.name: OpenAI
entity.domain: Artificial intelligence research, large language models, AI products and services
facts: Founded in 2015 as a non-profit AI research lab, restructured with a capped-profit arm in 2019
Led by CEO Sam Altman, who was briefly fired and reinstated by the board in November 2023
Created the GPT series of large language models (GPT-2, GPT-3, GPT-4, GPT-4o)
Launched ChatGPT in November 2022, reaching 100 million users in two months
Developed DALL-E for image generation and Whisper for speech recognition
Received a major investment from Microsoft, reportedly over $10 billion
Released the OpenAI API, powering thousands of third-party applications
Published influential research on scaling laws, RLHF, and instruction tuning
Transitioned from open publication of model weights to closed-source releases starting with GPT-4
Faced criticism for lack of transparency despite 'Open' in the name
Several co-founders departed including Ilya Sutskever, Elon Musk, and John Schulman
Operates ChatGPT Plus, Team, and Enterprise subscription tiers
Released the o1 and o3 reasoning model series in 2024-2025
Subject of multiple lawsuits from content creators over training data usage
Competes primarily with Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Meta AI
Announced plans to convert fully to a for-profit corporation in 2025
Pioneered reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for alignment at scale
